name: Describe Leads
summary: Lists every lead field available in your Marketo instance, with its REST API name, data type, and whether it's read-only.
whenToUse: Use this to discover field names before other calls — for example to build a 'fields to return' list, or to learn which fields exist and what they're called.

response.description: Array of field metadata: name (REST API name), restApiName, dataType, label (friendly name), readOnly, length.

notes: No fields required — this call just works.
Other calls expect the REST API name (e.g. 'email'), not the friendly label (e.g. 'Email Address').
